ci.name: Bianchi IX history coarse-graining audit
ci.scope: Five lightweight tests; exact block-sum coarse graining of the validated 9x9 history decoherence matrix; saved-baseline regression; artifact retention.

scope_note: Derived from the validated fine history D matrix; no new time evolution. A-vs-{B+,B-} improves strict decoherence to the scale of the two-resolution numerical control but does not establish it. Fully ignoring the second time is diagonal by construction.
